text_block_list.text:
One evening, I caught sight of Air Groove 
running along the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Pathetic. What am I doing 
getting out of breath over something like 
this...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"As I thought, my stamina has dropped even 
more than before..."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean my training volume isn't 
enough?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then I must train all the harder...!

Air Groove seems to be pushed to the brink 
by exhaustion. Perhaps we should 
reconsider her race schedule...
